source_only_inventory.command:
env PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONMALLOC=pymalloc PYTHONPATH=peano-lab/py /Library/Frameworks/Python.framework/Versions/3.10/bin/python3 -B - <<'PY'
import ast,hashlib,importlib.util,json,resource,signal,sys,time
from pathlib import Path
resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(170,175));signal.alarm(180)
started=time.monotonic();root=Path.cwd();relative='research/arithmetic-library/working/prime-field-alignment-v1/prime_field_polynomial_alignment_candidate.py';source=root/relative
raw=source.read_bytes();assert len(raw)==11780 and hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()=='eb16e2eb02dbd66a7706e616388182992b8cf2e0715818dc1f7748938e7d798e'
ast.parse(raw)
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('alignment_source_metadata_only',source);assert spec and spec.loader
module=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(module)
from peano_lab.library.theorems import TheoremSpec
rows=module.make_prime_field_polynomial_alignment_candidate_theorems(TheoremSpec)
digest=hashlib.sha256()
for row in rows:digest.update((json.dumps([row.name,row.statement,list(row.dependencies),list(row.script),row.summary],ensure_ascii=True,separators=(',',':'))+'\n').encode())
assert source.read_bytes()==raw and len(rows)==7 and sum(len(row.dependencies) for row in rows)==10
assert [len(row.script) for row in rows]==[42,14,46,50,27,63,16]
assert not any(name.startswith('peano_lab.library.editions') for name in sys.modules)
peak=resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss;assert peak<=1536*1024*1024
print(json.dumps({'scope':'actual frozen source inventory only; no proof or Alpha acceptance','source':relative,'bytes':len(raw),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),'rows':len(rows),'dependencies':[list(row.dependencies) for row in rows],'names':[row.name for row in rows],'commands':[len(row.script) for row in rows],'specs_sha256':digest.hexdigest(),'statement_sha256':[hashlib.sha256(row.statement.encode()).hexdigest() for row in rows],'cpu_limits':list(resource.getrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU)),'wall_alarm_seconds':180,'peak_rss_bytes':peak,'seconds':time.monotonic()-started,'source_unchanged':True,'proof_calls':0,'alpha_imported':False},sort_keys=True))
PY
